title: Global Net Lease, Inc. Announces Common Stock Dividend for the Second Quarter 2026
summary: NEW YORK, April 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Global Net Lease, Inc. (“GNL” or the “Company”) (NYSE: GNL / GNL PRA / GNL PRB / GNL PRD / GNL PRE) announced today that it declared a dividend of $0.190 per share of common stock payable on April 17, 2026, to common stockholders of record at the close of business on April 13, 2026. Dividends authorized by the Company’s board of directors and declared by the Company are paid on a quarterly basis in arrears during the first month following the end of each fiscal quarter (unless otherwise specified) to common stockholders of record on the record date for such payment. About Global Net Lease, Inc. Global Net Lease, Inc. (NYSE: GNL) is a publicly traded internally managed real estate investment trust that focuses on acquiring and managing a global portfolio of income producing net lease assets across the U.S., and Western and Northern Europe. Additional information about GNL can be found on its website at www.globalnetlease.com . Important
